annotations.title: Find UK shops with a sale on in a category

description: Finds which UK shops have a sale on today in one product category, such as electricals, fashion or furniture: one sale per shop, up to five, each with its start and end dates and a link. From January Sales' listings of UK shops' sales all year round.
name: list_category_sales

hasMore.description: True when the page lists more running sales

ends.description: The day it ends or ended, UK time, when it has an end date

linkUrl.description: January Sales' link to the sale at the shop, while it runs

started.description: The day the sale started, UK time (yyyy-mm-dd)

suggestions.description: Category names to try when nothing matched

title: Find UK shops with a sale on in a category
